steps.content: You dash to the middle of the square. The fog is still there, but the people you talked to are nowhere to be found.
Only Hannah, who didn't have her "worries severed," runs back home to her mother's side, sobbing all the way. She's still the most important person to her, and the person she needs most.
If Adela gets to Hannah first, what will happen to Hannah's mother? And what will happen to those whose "worries" have already been severed by her?
You shudder in anxiety and fear at the thought of all those blank and dazed faces.
Stop letting the shears control you! Stop! Come back!!
Isn't this the street you cherish?! Aren't these the people you care about? Don't hurt them! You shouldn't do this!
The thick fog devours even your echoes. You get no response. You want to run, but there's nowhere to run to.
Who else is there? Who else would she attack? Who else on Sloane Street...
...Yeah... Isn't the answer the obvious?
Realizing this, your legs go weak and you slump to the ground.
The surroundings have completely quieted down. No more strange hair, no more Mad Shears, and no more hysterical screams for help.
That's right. Adela has "severed" everyone here.

Unable to shake off her past, Andrea abandons her conscience. Socially awkward Ritz dumps his troublesome lover, and idealistic Kentor quits his job. All of them are no longer pestered by their past worries.
Plus that extreme worrywart of a woman whom you don't know and who had been controlled by the shears.

The clock chimes ten times through the fog. Adela said that she usually leaves work at around 10 o'clock. No wonder she hasn't come for you yet... She's probably cleaning up her salon right now. She likes to stick to her schedule.
You had planned to go pick her up. Now, she'll be coming to find you soon, with that crazy pair of shears.
How will you deal with her now?
With your missing power?
With your incomplete memory?
With...
Just yourself alone?

Are the shears controlling Adela, too? Or is that a lie, too? If she knew the truth from the beginning, what went on in her mind when she watched you rush around these few days doing your investigation?
She was once your only confidante, but now, she's your only worry. Other than that, you have nothing.
Something suddenly slams you in the back, then jumps and hangs onto your neck.

steps.speaker: Short Shadow Girl
steps.content: Big... bad... dummy... gimme... pocket... money—!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: ...Is this what you were like before, too? Pestering others when they have important things to do?

steps.speaker: Short Shadow Girl
steps.content: Important things? What important things? Who gives a damn about that!

steps.speaker: Short Shadow Girl
steps.content: Pocket money pocket money pocket money pocket money!!
She totally disregards your worries, hanging and swinging from your neck with a playful smile. You can't help but sigh.

steps.speaker: Tall Shadow Girl
steps.content: You feel tired, Chief? Are we bothering you?

steps.speaker: Tall Shadow Girl
steps.content: I see... I couldn't help Chief, and became a burden instead. My very existence is a burden to Chief. I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Tall Shadow Girl
steps.content: Can Mad Shears completely get rid of people's worries? If it severs me, will Chief be able to stop worrying about me?

steps.speaker: Tall Shadow Girl
steps.content: Then I'll go find Mad Shears right now...
She grabs the short shadow and tries to leave, but you grab both of them.

steps.speaker: Short Shadow Girl
steps.content: Pocket money pocket money gimme pocket money you big dummy!!

steps.speaker: Tall Shadow Girl
steps.content: Can't let Chief worry, can't let Chief worry...
How can I forget about you two little troublemakers...
As you say that, you give the two of them a big hug.

Amidst all the pesky, tiresome and infuriating "worries", there are some that one wants to hold on to no matter how annoying they are. It's not that one can't get rid of them, but because they are treasures that one can't bear to part with.

options: Thank you for keep pestering me.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Come back to me, my "worries"...

In your embrace, the two apparitions dissolve into specks of red light and return to your palm, gradually restoring your memories and clearing your dazed mind. You can feel that there are those who care about you on the other side of the shackles.
Now, it's time to go on a date with Adela.
